title: Final Angle Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state the equation for tan(theta) in terms of beta and gamma.

title: Angle Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must calculate the angle theta for the case where bar(theta) = 90 degrees accurately.

title: Maximum Angle Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the condition for the maximum angle observed in the laboratory.

title: Momentum Application
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply the given momentum to find the corresponding beta value for the meson.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes in the transformation equations.

title: Final Answer Presentation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must present the final answers clearly and in the correct format.

title: Limiting Cases Discussion
description: Optional Criteria: The student could discuss limiting cases for theta when bar(theta) approaches 0 or 180 degrees.
